title: Book 4 — Melpomene, Chapter 176
paragraphs: Next to these Macae are the Gindanes, whose women each wear a number of anklets made of the skins of animals, for the following reason, as is said: for every man who has had intercourse with her, a woman binds on an anklet; and the woman who has the most is considered the best, since she has been loved by the greatest number of men.
